# netskope_aig_appliance_enrollment_token (Resource)

Generates an enrollment JWT token for an AI Gateway (AIG) appliance. The token is used to register the appliance with the Netskope tenant. Tokens expire 24 hours after generation.

This is a create-only resource — each apply generates a new token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_aig_appliance_enrollment_token" "my_aigapplianceenrollmenttoken" {
  appliance_id = "019c88b6-a197-70a2-9122-435a8e4af4cb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `appliance_id` (String) UUID of the AIG appliance to generate an enrollment token for. Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `enrollment_token` (String, Sensitive) JWT token used to enroll/register the appliance with the Netskope
tenant. Valid for 24 hours from generation.
- `expire_time` (String) Token expiration timestamp (24 hours from creation).
